missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Пиджак' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'идёт'. 'Этот' is the agreeing masculine demonstrative, and 'тебе' is the dative experiencer who looks good in it.

Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Пиджак' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative matches the nominative. 'Новый' agrees in the masculine accusative, and 'купил' marks the completed purchase.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. After 'нет' the noun takes the genitive 'пиджака'. 'Тёплого' is the agreeing masculine genitive adjective, expressing what is missing from the wardrobe.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'От пиджака' uses the genitive after 'от' to mark separation. 'Пуговица' is the nominative subject that came off. A practical clothing-repair sentence.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К пиджаку' takes the dative after 'к' to show addition or attachment. 'Карман' is the accusative object that was added. Useful for describing alterations.

Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В пиджаке' uses the prepositional 'пиджаке' after 'в' to describe what someone is wearing. 'Строгом' agrees in the masculine prepositional, marking a formal look.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Под пиджаком' uses the instrumental after 'под' to express location underneath. 'Рубашка' is the nominative subject. A neat layering description.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a number. After 'два' the noun takes the genitive singular 'пиджака'. 'Висят' agrees with the plural notion, and 'в шкафу' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Пиджаки' is the nominative plural subject of 'висят'. 'Все' is the agreeing plural quantifier, and 'в гардеробе' gives the prepositional location.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Пиджаки' is the inanimate masculine plural accusative, matching the nominative plural. 'Мужские' agrees in the plural, and 'продаёт' takes it as its object.
